resources.string: %1$s moved the bridge\'s car Wi-Fi to %2$s
The bridge talks to the car over one Wi-Fi radio and to your home network over another (or a cable). With a USB Wi-Fi adapter plugged in, pick the radio that sees the car best.
Only one Wi-Fi radio found. Plug a USB Wi-Fi adapter into the bridge to choose.
The bridge moves the car\'s Wi-Fi to %1$s and restarts. The car is out of touch for about a minute.
Update the bridge first (Settings → Bridge → Update) — its Wi-Fi helper is too old for this.
